title: difrad
intro:
The ’difrad’ component should calculate the diffuse radiation from meterological
data.

sections.name: BRL
sections.desc:
Diffuse radiation calculation based on the model of Ridley et al., 2010. Last pre-
dictor (persistence) is not taken into account. See also [Ridley et al., 2010]

attrs.name: beta1
attrs.doc: 2nd parameter (hourly clearness index) of BRL model.

attrs.name: beta2
attrs.doc: 3rd parameter (apparent solar time) of BRL model.

attrs.name: beta4
attrs.doc: 5th parameter (daily clearness index) of BRL model.

sections.text:
Diffuse radiation calculation based on the model of Ridley et al., 2010. Last pre-
dictor (persistence) is not taken into account. See also [Ridley et al., 2010]
   < BRL (beta0 -2.4 [])
            (beta1 2.77 [])
            (beta2 0.033 [])
            (beta3 0.054 [])
            (beta4 1.028 []) >

    beta0 : number (dimensionless)
     Parameter (default -2.4)
     1st parameter (constant) of BRL model.

    beta1 : number (dimensionless)
     Parameter (default 2.77)
     2nd parameter (hourly clearness index) of BRL model.

    beta2 : number (dimensionless)
     Parameter (default 0.033)
     3rd parameter (apparent solar time) of BRL model.

    beta3 : number (dimensionless)
     Parameter (default 0.054)
     4th parameter (solar altitude) of BRL model.

    beta4 : number (dimensionless)
     Parameter (default 1.028)
     5th parameter (daily clearness index) of BRL model.

sections.name: DPF
sections.desc:
Diffuse radiation calculated using the model of De Pury and Farquhar, 1997. See
also [de Pury and Farquhar, 1997]

attrs.name: a
attrs.doc:
Value description: Table 5 in cited paper.
        Atmospheric transmission coefficient of PAR. Value around 0.6-0.9 depending
        on dust particles.

attrs.name: fa
attrs.doc:
Value description: Table 2 in cited paper.
        Forward scattering coefficient of PAR in the atmosphere.

sections.text:
Diffuse radiation calculated using the model of De Pury and Farquhar, 1997. See
also [de Pury and Farquhar, 1997]
   < DPF (a 0.72 [])
            (fa 0.426 [<fraction>]) >

       a: number (dimensionless)
        Parameter (default 0.72)
        Value description: Table 5 in cited paper.
        Atmospheric transmission coefficient of PAR. Value around 0.6-0.9 depending
        on dust particles.
       fa: number [<fraction>]
        Parameter (default 0.426)
        Value description: Table 2 in cited paper.
        Forward scattering coefficient of PAR in the atmosphere.
